svg.aria-label: Happy Birthday as a single-note tab
svg.title: Happy Birthday as a single-note tab
svg.text: "Happy Birthday": C major, 3/4, 80 beats a minute
Public domain in both the US and the EU, with no disputed version—a good test of first position
Three beats a bar: beat 1 is two eighth notes, beats 2 and 3 are quarter notes each
High do is string 2 fret 1, high re string 2 fret 3, high sol string 1 fret 3
